scripts.dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.dev:server: cd server && cross-env NODE_ENV=development npm run dev
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.lint: npm run lint:server && npm run lint:client
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:server:fix && npm run lint:client:fix
scripts.format: npm run format:server && npm run format:client
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check:server && npm run type-check:client
scripts.ci:test: npm run lint && npm run test:ci && npm run build
scripts.ci:full: npm run ci:test && npm run test:e2e
